name: Hold to Confirm
hint: Press and hold. Let go early to cancel.
description: A destructive action that must be held rather than clicked. A fill sweeps across while held, drains on a spring if released early, and pops into a done state on completion. Works with Space/Enter held down.
usage: Use instead of an 'Are you sure?' dialog for destructive actions people take often enough that a modal is annoying. Pass `label`, `doneLabel` and `onConfirm`. If `onConfirm` returns a promise (an async function), the button stays full and busy (spinner, `busyLabel`, cannot be held again) until it settles: resolve and it shows `doneLabel` for `resetAfter` ms, then resets by itself; reject (rethrow after showing your error) and it drains straight back so it can be held again. If your work is tracked elsewhere, set `busy` instead. Keep the hint visible: it takes its own space under the button (`hintPlacement` moves it), and the root keeps its own width in a flex column or grid cell, so no wrapper is needed.

dataProps.description: () => void | Promise. Called once when a hold completes. Return a promise to keep the button busy until it settles: resolved shows doneLabel then resets after resetAfter; rejected drains back to idle with no done state (show your own error). Returning nothing shows doneLabel straight away.
Button text before and while holding.
Text shown (and announced) after a confirmed hold, for resetAfter ms.
Text while the promise from onConfirm is pending or `busy` is true, next to a spinner. Defaults to doneLabel.

Caller-owned busy state: the fill stays full, a spinner shows with busyLabel, aria-busy is set and it cannot be held again until you clear it. Clearing it drains the fill unless a done state is showing.
Milliseconds the done state shows before the button resets itself and can be held again. It always resets; unmount it or set `disabled` if it must not be used again.
Milliseconds the hold takes to fill.
Hint under the button at rest. Blank with a blank holdingHint shows no hint.
Hint while it is being held.
Where the hint sits. below / above / end take their own space in the layout; overlay is the old look (absolutely positioned under the button, taking no space; the caller must leave room).
Show the hint. The button keeps aria-describedby pointing at it.
Icon before the label: a built-in icon name or a node; null for none.
() => void, when a hold begins (pointer down or Space/Enter).
(progress: number) => void, when a hold is released before it completes; progress is 0–1.
Not holdable or focusable; the label stays at least 3:1 against the page so it can still be read.
Other attributes (aria-*, data-*, id, event handlers) go to the <button>; className and style go to the root.
The <button>: focus it, or measure it.
